annotations.text:
TWO REGISTERS, ON PURPOSE

The gate is calm and the console behind it is dense. That reads as a
contradiction until you notice nobody is working on the login screen -- it
holds one decision, so restraint is affordable there and density is not.

The gate is glass and monochrome: a lit pane over the construction lines,
hairline fields, one white key. Green is spent entirely on the console
screens below, where it means something -- a score, a freeze, a hit. Spending
it on a sign-in button was spending the product's one colour on nothing.
